title: Build the launch-time availability checks and the refusal path
statement: At every launch resolve the recorded selection, verify an authentication source is configured, verify the package and required tools loaded, verify a matching compatibility record exists, and refuse the run with a specific reason when any check fails.
notes: ⚠️ DEPENDS ON TSK-0042, ADDED 2026-09-22 (B1). The fourth launch check needs the full compatibility key, including the preflight contract digest, and only TSK-0042 (on TSK-0041's canary contract) computes it and writes the record. Without it no launch can show a matching record. ⚠️ THE EXPECTED KEY IS COMPUTED FROM THE CURRENT RUNTIME INPUTS at launch, never read back from the stored record, or the comparison compares the record with itself. ⚠️ A DIFFERENT-MODEL ONE-RUN OVERRIDE NEEDS A ROUTE TO MATCHING COMPATIBILITY PROOF, or the override offered as a remedy can never start a run. ⚠️ WIRED 2026-09-22 (EVD-0132). bin/start-kiln.mjs runs the checks before the supervisor starts anything, with the one-run override flags and a live-canary runner, and holds Pi to the selection that passed. The component work is EVD-0129, and EVD-0131 made the key computable from the resolved model and effective endpoint. ⚠️ STILL OWED: a custom provider cannot launch until the command can supply its credential declaration and provider configuration (D25, D13), and setup (TSK-0060) must call the setup-side live model check so a project's first record is written by setup.
